name: OpenClaw
description: Full-featured AI assistant with memory support

install.command: bash -c 'SCRIPT=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL -o "$SCRIPT" "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/install.sh" && curl -fsSL -o "$SCRIPT.sha256" "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/install.sh.sha256" && echo "  $SCRIPT" >> "$SCRIPT.sha256" && sha256sum -c "$SCRIPT.sha256" && bash "$SCRIPT" && rm -f "$SCRIPT" "$SCRIPT.sha256"'

platforms.linux: bash -c 'SCRIPT=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL -o "$SCRIPT" "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/install.sh" && curl -fsSL -o "$SCRIPT.sha256" "https://github.com/Keith-CY/carrier/releases/download/v1.0.0/install.sh.sha256" && echo "  $SCRIPT" >> "$SCRIPT.sha256" && sha256sum -c "$SCRIPT.sha256" && bash "$SCRIPT" && rm -f "$SCRIPT" "$SCRIPT.sha256"'
